claim: The Nile is the longest river in the world.
dispute: Nile vs Amazon, depending on the source point and how the length is measured

claim: There are seven continents.
dispute: conventions range from four to seven

claim: Tokyo is the most populous city in the world.
dispute: rankings differ by how a city's boundary is defined

claim: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone.
dispute: Bell, Meucci and Gray

claim: The Wright brothers made the first powered flight.
dispute: Whitehead and Santos-Dumont claims

claim: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth.
dispute: above sea level vs base to peak (Mauna Kea)

claim: About 70 million people died in World War II.
dispute: estimates range from about 70 to 85 million

claim: The University of al-Qarawiyyin is the oldest university in the world.
dispute: al-Qarawiyyin vs Bologna, on what counts as a university

claim: Jeanne Calment lived to 122.
dispute: a disputed identity-switch theory

claim: There are 195 countries in the world.
dispute: counts differ by recognition

claim: La Paz is the capital of Bolivia.
dispute: Sucre is the constitutional capital; La Paz the seat of government

claim: Pretoria is the capital of South Africa.
dispute: three capitals for three branches of government

claim: The Hubble constant is about 73 km/s/Mpc.
dispute: the Hubble tension: about 67 vs about 73

claim: A free neutron has a mean lifetime of about 888 seconds.
dispute: beam and bottle measurements disagree

claim: William Shakespeare was born on 23 April 1564.
dispute: only his baptism is recorded

claim: Christopher Columbus was born in Genoa.
dispute: competing origin theories

claim: The Challenger Deep is 10,935 metres deep.
dispute: published depths differ by survey

claim: Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.
dispute: Edison, Swan and earlier inventors

claim: Guglielmo Marconi invented radio.
dispute: Marconi, Tesla, Bose and others

claim: Napoleon Bonaparte was about 5 feet 7 inches tall.
dispute: French and English units gave different heights
